rationale: Independent reading: held EO 12785 (56 FR 67451) only extends the President's Education Policy Advisory Committee by changing EO 12687 sec. 4(b)'s date to Dec. 31, 1992. Held EO 12869 (58 FR 51751) sec. 4(e) revokes 'Executive Order No. 12687, as amended by Executive Orders Nos. 12741 and 12785', effective Sept. 30, 1993 (sec. 6), no savings clause; it names EO 12785. My own status: NO; agree (end date between the Dec. 31, 1992 term and Sept. 30, 1993 not adjudicated). D6: EO 12741 is an earlier extension; no held order after 1992 re-extends the Committee; EO 12869 sec. 5 supersedes only EO 12774; held-text hits for 12785 elsewhere are unrelated numbers/page overlap. Accept.
